breaking: Remote access now uses the iroh-based v2 protocol, which is incompatible with the previous v1/Noise transport. Upgrade the tunnel server and desktop clients together; the switch disconnects existing TCP sessions.
The standalone tunnel client's --client option has been removed. Remove it from scripts; each run now uses a temporary provider identity.
features: Desktop remote access now supports sharing local TCP ports with optional public access, connecting remote services to fixed local ports, and migrating legacy tunnel settings.
Choose automatic direct connections with relay fallback or relay-only mode, and inspect connection paths and active TCP streams. Headless tunnel clients can emit connection snapshots with --stats.

Add configurable session-completion reminders when Pi Desk is not focused, including system notifications, sounds, and Windows taskbar or macOS Dock attention indicators. Android supports native notifications and notification permission requests.
Plugin management now supports reloading selected or affected plugins, with clearer failure summaries and expandable error details.
added: Add a one-command Linux x86_64 gateway and relay deployment tool that pins image digests, generates keys, manages TLS certificates, and preserves existing configuration on repeat runs.
Add an interactive remote-device setup guide and syntax highlighting with copy controls for website Markdown code blocks.
changed: New tunnel clients build public addresses from the control-service hostname and published port rather than the server-supplied hostname. Deployments with separate control and business hosts must account for this; older v2 clients still use the server-configured address.
macOS installation now uses a universal drag-and-drop DMG instead of the native installer.
Plugin reload can repair missing or incomplete remote packages while preserving enabled state and update channel, preferring pinned or locally installed versions rather than proactively upgrading.
Improve conversation branch-tree contrast, hierarchy guides, and current-position indicators.
Delay the To-do progress popover on hover to reduce accidental opening.
fixed: Restore chat auto-follow after sending or queuing a message, and improve scroll positioning when returning to a running conversation or reopening a hidden chat.
Improve managed-process shutdown on Unix to avoid lingering child processes and hangs caused by inherited output pipes.
Report tunnel cleanup failures instead of treating unconfirmed resource release as a successful stop, including in remote debugging.
